gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped keeps its curves open and unfussy, a plain sans with little to say about itself. And Shantell Sans takes the heading with a wide-mouthed, fixed-nib hand that makes the quiet text underneath feel even tidier.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-imprima: Shantell Sans brings a wide-mouthed, fixed-nib hand to the heading, while Imprima follows in smooth, tube-like lines with flared ends. The text goes down easily.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-inclusive-sans: Inclusive Sans reads round and businesslike, its curves finishing open-ended. Shantell Sans is best at showing off a loose, marker-like personality, whereas Inclusive Sans does its finest work staying out of the way once the lines get going.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-inria-sans: Bent copper pipe meets a wide-mouthed marker: Inria Sans is tubular and see-through in its openings, with Shantell Sans above it. They share a page like a doodle beside a diagram.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-istok-web: Istok Web is rounded, with a clearly open side. Shantell Sans adds a loose, expressive hand in the heading, and the sturdier text below it keeps the whole page friendly and grounded.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-jura: Wire-thin and precise, with wide-open curves. Down the page, Jura holds a steady line in every stroke, so the plain sans text moves smoothly beneath Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-k2d: Shantell Sans lands with a wide mouth and a single fixed nib width. Beneath it, K2D keeps a tube-like thickness through every bend, so the sans text moves along smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kanchenjunga: A wide mouth and one fixed nib width give Shantell Sans its handmade character. Kanchenjunga does the opposite job, holding a steady drafting-pen line in shapes that never clog at low resolution.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kantumruy-pro: Kantumruy Pro reads friendly and clean, its e opening clearly to the right with no hairlines or swells. Shantell Sans is the one with the personality, and the body stays out of its way.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kodchasan: Loose ends, no calligraphic thinning, a friendly wobble up top. Kodchasan keeps its terminals hanging open, so the plain sans text beneath Shantell Sans stays easy going all the way down.
